title: BANK OF AFRICA Seals Two Strategic Partnerships in Beijing, Deepening Morocco-China Ties
body:
BANK OF AFRICA has signed two strategic economic partnership agreements with major Chinese financial institutions during a high-profile Beijing visit, channelling Chinese investment through the bank's 35-country African network.

Strategic Context

The agreements reflect Morocco's position as China's preferred North African gateway. Tanger Med already handles significant Chinese cargo volumes. Marrakech could benefit through increased Chinese tourism — growing at 35% annually — and Chinese investment in the city's logistics zones.

Source: AlphaBourse and Kech24 financial reporting.
